2607.01965.title: Towards a Phonology-Informed Evaluation of Multilingual TTS
2607.01965.paper_summary: Neural TTS systems can sound natural across languages, but naturalness does not guarantee the preservation of sound contrasts that distinguish words from their grammatical forms. Standard metrics like MOS do not test for this. We propose a classifier-based framework that audits TTS output against language-specific phonological patterns using human speech as a benchmark. Testing Assamese advanced tongue root (ATR) vowel harmony with Meta's MMS TTS, we show that a classifier trained on human speech transfers to synthesized speech with minimal loss. The faithfulness audit reveals that [+ATR] mid vowels are realized as [-ATR] in 1/3 tokens despite an underlying [+ATR] specification, a bias absent in human speech. At the word level, predicted ATR labels classify harmony more accurately than transcription labels, indicating a gap between intended and produced phonology. The framework offers task-specific diagnostics and generalizes to other phonological contrasts with measurable acoustic cues.
2607.01965.paper_summary_zh: 神經 TTS 系統在多種語言中聽起來都很自然，但自然性並不保證能夠保留區分單詞與其語法形式的音響對比。標準度量如 MOS 並未測試這一點。我們提出了一個基於分類器的框架，使用人類語音作為基準，對 TTS 輸出進行語言特定的音系模式審核。通過測試阿薩姆語的先進舌根 (ATR) 元音和 Meta 的 MMS TTS，我們顯示一個在人體語音上訓練的分類器能夠以最小的損失轉移到合成語音上。忠實度審核顯示，儘管有潛在的 [+ATR] 規範，1/3 的標記中 [+ATR] 中元音卻被實現為 [-ATR]，這在人體語音中並不存在這種偏差。在單詞層面上，預測的 ATR 標籤比轉錄標籤更準確地分類和諧，這表明意圖與產出音系之間存在差距。該框架提供了特定任務的診斷，並可推廣到其他具有可測量聲學線索的音系對比中。
